name: Fitness First student discount
summary: 20% off full-priced Fitness First memberships for current students at any Australian institution.
key: Fitness First offers students 20% off on full priced 3 month, 12- and 18-month memberships.
who: Current student at an Australian institution with a valid student ID.
Aged 14 or over, and not a Fitness First member in the previous 90 days.
how: Fill in the form on the page or visit a club, and bring your student ID.
catches: Subject to the membership contract and terms.
